hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels validates each reservation entry independently against the same un-decremented available_quantity. A single cart holding OVS-PIECE (1 WIDGET) and OVS-TWOPACK (2 WIDGET) produces two entries for the same WIDGET level in one createReservationItems batch. With WIDGET stocked at 2, the combined demand of 3 should be rejected, but each entry individually fits, so the completion succeeds and reserves 3 against 2 stock. The no_oversell and reserved_matches_reservations checks should fail on that run. Using two carts that each need 3 units, raced together, makes the oversell show up in every run.
submitted_scenario:
schema: oversold.scenario/v1
name: shared-item-bundle-batch
description: >
  Two carts share the WIDGET inventory item through different variants. Each
  cart holds one OVS-PIECE and one OVS-TWOPACK, so each needs 3 WIDGET units
  against 2 stocked. Both are completed at once. The batch reservation should
  reject the summed demand, but the per-entry check lets it through.
target:
  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 1
stock:
  WIDGET: 2
carts:
  alice:
    server: 1
    lines:
      - sku: OVS-PIECE
        qty: 1
      - sku: OVS-TWOPACK
        qty: 1
  bob:
    server: 1
    lines:
      - sku: OVS-PIECE
        qty: 1
      - sku: OVS-TWOPACK
        qty: 1
race:
  - id: alice-complete
    server: 1
    do: complete
    cart: alice
  - id: bob-complete
    server: 1
    do: complete
    cart: bob
timing:
  release: together
  jitter_ms: [0, 3]
  request_timeout_ms: 10000
faults: []
runs: 20
seed: 20261028
checks:
  - no_oversell
  - reserved_matches_reservations
  - one_order_per_cart
  - no_orphaned_orders
  - no_missing_orders
